jobs.description:
Build upon your classroom studies through our Hotel Internship Program opportunities. You will learn first-hand about a hotel's operations. Our Hotel Internship Program allows you to truly experience the industry from the ground up, where our founders and many of our leaders began. You will get immersed in Marriott's culture and business and find your true calling in the travel industry. Our internships are typically available in many different areas of the hotel. By gaining hands-on experience in the exciting world of hotel management, you'll be better prepared to pursue opportunities post graduation. Here's to exploring, kickstarting your dream career, and joining us on your journey!

To be considered for an internship, you must be a current college or university student. Want to join us? Apply now!

Marriott International is the world's largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. We believe a great career is a journey of discovery and exploration. So, we ask, where will your journey take you?

marriotthotelinternship

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of "Wonderful Hospitality. Always." by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that's synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
 JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you're happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand's namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you'll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That's The JW Treatment. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Il nostro Hotel Internship Program ti permette di sperimentare veramente l'industria da zero, dove i nostri fondatori e molti dei nostri leader hanno cominciato. Ti immergerai nella cultura e nel business di Marriott e troverai la tua vera vocazione nel settore dei viaggi. I nostri stage sono tipicamente disponibili in molte diverse aree dell'hotel. Guadagnando esperienza pratica nel mondo emozionante della gestione alberghiera, sarete meglio preparati a perseguire opportunità post laurea. Ecco per esplorare, iniziare la tua carriera da sogno, e unirsi a noi nel tuo viaggio!

Marriott International è la più grande società alberghiera del mondo, con più marchi, più hotel e più opportunità per i soci di crescere e avere successo. Crediamo che una grande carriera sia un viaggio di scoperta ed esplorazione. Allora, chiediamo, dove vi portera' il vostro viaggio?

marriotthotelinternship

A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

Marriott Hotels si sforza di elevare l'arte dell'ospitalità, innovando in ogni occasione, mantenendo il comfort del oh-so-familiare in tutto il mondo. Come ospite di Marriott Hotels, vi aiuterà a mantenere la promessa di "Ospitalità meravigliosa. Sempre." consegnando un servizio pensieroso, sentito, in avanti che sostiene e costruisce su questa eredità vivente. Con il nome che è sinonimo di ospitalità in tutto il mondo, siamo orgogliosi di darvi il benvenuto per esplorare una carriera con Marriott Hotels. Entrando in Marriott Hotels, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.
JW Marriott fa parte del portafoglio di lusso di Marriott International e si compone di oltre 100 belle proprietà nelle città di gateway e località turistiche distintive in tutto il mondo. JW crede che i nostri associati vengano prima. Perche' se sei felice, i nostri ospiti saranno felici. I soci JW Marriott sono fiduciosi, innovativi, genuini, intuitivi e portano avanti l'eredità dell'omonimo marchio e del fondatore della società, J.Willard Marriott. I nostri hotel offrono un'esperienza di lavoro diversa da qualsiasi altra, dove sarete parte di una comunità e godere di vera camaraderie con un gruppo diversificato di collaboratori. JW crea opportunità di formazione, sviluppo, riconoscimento e, soprattutto, un luogo in cui è possibile perseguire le vostre passioni in un ambiente di lusso con un focus sul benessere olistico. Trattare gli ospiti eccezionalmente inizia con il modo in cui ci prendiamo cura dei nostri associati. E' il trattamento JW. Nell'unione di JW Marriott, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

As a member of the HR department of the hotel, this role collaborates closely with HR colleagues. You will support the daily operations of the Human Resources Office, including recruitment and learning. You will be part of a team of four, enjoying a positive and collaborative work atmosphere. This position is committed to delivering high-quality HR services that drive business success while ensuring full compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

As Talents & Trainings Assistant, you report directly to the Recruitment & Talents Manager :

YOUR ROLE :

• Assist the Recruitment Manager throughout the recruitment process within the hotel (open & follow up on job requisition of the different channels)

• Provide support for internal training programs (DLZ, Whatever/Whenever, Welcome Day, etc.)

• Manage requests for extras from the various departments and follow up on them

• Manage internal communications across the various communication channels and in-house

• Ensure that recruitment materials are kept up to date and that Marriott procedures are followed

• Manage a part of the staff accommodation (check-in/check-out inventory & follow up)

• You are responsible for apprentices and trainees at the hotel (Participation to the career fairs at hospitality schools, recruiting apprentices, follow up with the various organizations)

PROFILE :

• Previous experience in Human Resources

• Fluency in English and French; knowledge of other languages is an advantage

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build positive relationships with partners, managers and candidates

• Enjoy working in a bold, international team

• Excellent presentation skills that reflect the W brand image

• A genuine interest in the worlds of taste, sound, the body, the stage and taking a stand

Ready to take on this challenge and join the HR team? Join us and be part of an adventure where every detail counts

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

In qualità di Talents & Trainings Assistant, riferisci direttamente al Recruitment & Talents Manager:

• Gestione delle comunicazioni interne attraverso i vari canali di comunicazione e in-house

• Gestire una parte del personale alloggio (check-in / check-out inventario & follow up)

• Siete responsabili degli apprendisti e dei tirocinanti dell'hotel (partecipazione alle fiere di carriera presso le scuole di ospitalità, reclutando apprendisti, seguire con le varie organizzazioni)

PROFILE:

• Esperienza precedente in Risorse Umane

• Fluency in inglese e francese; la conoscenza di altre lingue è un vantaggio

• Forte capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione per costruire relazioni positive con partner, manager e candidati

• Godetevi il lavoro in un team internazionale audace

• Eccellente capacità di presentazione che riflettono l'immagine del marchio W

• Un autentico interesse per i mondi del gusto, del suono, del corpo, del palcoscenico e della presa di posizione

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

JOB SUMMARY
 Marriott International, Inc. has entered a joint venture with the Leali family, founders of Lefay, to bring the highly regarded luxury wellness hospitality brand into Marriott's global portfolio. The joint venture, which is equally owned by Marriott and the Leali Family, owns the brand and intellectual property assets, and is focused on growing the Lefay around the world.
 This Manager Entity Reporting & Tax - JV is a key member of the Lefay Joint Venture. This position reports directly to the Managing Director of the Lefay Joint Venture with dotted-line reporting to Marriott International’s Director Policy & Governance – EMEA on the Marriott EMEA Finance & Tax team. This position supports the timely preparation and filing of statutory accounts for the Italian and Swiss Joint Venture legal entities, coordinates with Marriott and external auditors, and supports all aspects of local income tax compliance for the Joint Venture.
 Responsibilities include assisting with financial statement preparation, coordination, preparation and filing of tax returns for entities incorporated and/or tax resident in the Continent including estimated payments, informative returns and withholding tax filing, VAT returns and payments. The Manager Entity Reporting & Tax works with independence, but within established guidelines, producing and analysing financial information as well as legal contracts to support the accounting and tax for subsidiaries. In addition, he/she will serve as a contact for entity questions/issues for stakeholders across the organisation as it pertains to countries across EMEA.
 SCOPE/BUSINESS CONTEXT/EXPECTED CONTRIBUTIONS

• Preparation and delivery of information required for the filing of the annual statutory accounts for varying entities within EMEA, including the financial statements and the excel files containing the current years activity

• Work with the company auditors and tax advisors to deliver the information required to perform the audits and submission of tax returns in a timely manner

• Prepare financial analysis to the JV accounting team at HQ

• Work with Research and Planning team for any tax audits within the JV’s

• Recording journal entries as necessary

• Review, verify, and update withholding tax rates in the owner billing database. Research and resolve owner billing disputes in relation to withholding tax.

• Recommend ways to bring programs and operations into compliance with goals and objectives

• Partner with Tax, Treasury Accounting Services, Corporate & Statutory Accounting, Treasury, Legal and all other interested parties

• Assist with the quarterly Balance Sheet Reconciliation certification process (known as MIP66) for EMEA entities

• Work with MI HQ to fulfil the continents income tax accounting responsibilities including providing support for the reconciliation of the current tax liability, preparation of complex deferred tax analyses, preparation or review of local tax provisions and the timely and review of OneSource

• Partner with hotel Directors of Finance as appropriate

• Maintain accurate and detailed working papers in the agreed standard format

• Perform any other tasks as assigned by the Lefay Joint Venture Managing Director or the Director Policy & Governance - EMEA

• Knowledge of Peoplesoft

• Ability to establish and retain effective working relationships with external agencies, hotel management and associates

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both orally and in writing
